name: thikano
description: THIKANO — the operating system for PGs & hostels.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @thikano/${THIKANO_APP:?set THIKANO_APP to web, owner or admin}
scripts.start: npm run serve -w @thikano/${THIKANO_APP:?set THIKANO_APP to web, owner or admin}
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w @thikano/functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-thikano
scripts.test:firebase: npm run build -w @thikano/functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --project demo-thikano "npm run test -w @thikano/firebase-tests"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @thikano/functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-thikano --export-on-exit=e2e/.emulator-data "npm run seed" && node tools/wait-ports-free.mjs 8080 9099 4400 4500 && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --project demo-thikano --import=e2e/.emulator-data "npm run test -w @thikano/e2e"
